label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Niemann’s 8th LIV Title
items.text: Joaquin Niemann won the LIV Golf Korea playoff over Talor Gooch for his eighth LIV title, the most since 2022, amid LIV seeking new investors after Saudi PIF funding ends after 2026.

items.headline: Potgieter’s NCAA Bogey Record
items.text: Louisiana's Malan Potgieter extended his bogey-free streak to 91 holes at the NCAA Championship, surpassing the previous NCAA record and approaching Tiger Woods’ pro record of 110.
